name: @orbb/clinical
description: Clinical organization/clinic/practitioner domain for ORBB (M7-A A44 + A45, Lane A): the A44 entity model — Organization, Clinic, and Practitioner aggregates with kernel-discipline transition tables (practitioner verification is an explicit, auditable step, never implied) plus PractitionerOrganizationMembership and PractitionerClinicAffiliation aggregates with a frozen role vocabulary — and the A45 patient-linking and care-team permissions model: the consent-shaped PatientLink lifecycle (a practitioner may request but NEVER self-confirm; an unconfirmed link confers NOTHING), the additive-event CareTeam composition, and the pure deny-by-default care-team permission evaluator layered ON TOP of the real kernel access evaluation (@orbb/domain AccessGrant + evaluateAccess) — every failure mode denies with a distinct typed reason and every decision carries an audit record shaped for access_audits. Boundary-shaped, non-authoritative, SYNTH-fixtured. Zero external runtime dependencies.
